verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions workflows are written in YAML (gitea-docs-2), and Gitea itself provides commit history plus Pull Request and AGit review flows (gitea-docs-1, gitea-docs-3, gitea-docs-24). Together these suggest automations can be versioned and reviewed as code, but the evidence never states that workflows live in the repository or documents a rollback path for them. missing for 10: explicit docs that workflow files are versioned in the repo, a documented rollback or revert process for automations, hands-on corroboration of a review-and-rollback workflow for automations.
